text:
<subject>Re: Urgent: Outstanding Invoice for MedSys Services Due by COB Tues 27/11</subject>
<body>
Alain -- I was under the impression that Lumière Santé had completed MedSys’s credit verification last week; however, below is a reminder that the invoice remains unsettled and Lumière Santé risks suspension from MedSys clinical data platforms if payment is not received by 27/11 COB.

Please let us know if Clinical Operations should contact MedSys directly to resolve this. Jacqueline 37007.
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message----- 
From: Martin, Richard 
Sent: Wed 19/11/2025 09:20 
To: Guilbert, Jacqueline; Robin, Philippe 
Cc: Boulay, Hugues; Laine, Emmanuel 
Subject: FW: MedSys AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th PAYMENT TO MedSys IS OVERDUE

FYI 

-----Original Message----- 
From: d992@medsyscorp.com 
Sent: Tuesday, 18 November 2025 20:43 
To: helene.pruvost@lumieresante.fr; victor.hoarau@lumieresante.fr 
Cc: d742@healthsol.com; l184@healthsol.com 
Subject: MedSys AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th PAYMENT TO MedSys IS OVERDUE 
Importance: High 

> This is your formal notice that MedSys now considers your organization in breach of 
> the MedSys Data Access Agreement for non-payment of your 5 November 2025 
> invoice by 13:00 today. Pursuant to Section 15.1.3 of MedSys’s agreement, you have three business days to cure 
> this breach by remitting full payment. If payment is not received by close of business on Tuesday, 25 November 2025, MedSys will declare 
> Lumière Santé in default, terminating your rights to participate in MedSys governance meetings, to access clinical data platforms, and to receive 
> software updates from MedSys. Furthermore, all MedSys members will be notified tomorrow of any organizations failing to meet their payment obligations for October services. 
> 
> For any questions regarding this notice or the outstanding amount, please contact Margot Ferreira at +33 4 19 32 69 07 or Olivier Le Roux at 
> +33 4 71 47 75 05. 
> 
> Camille Mallet 
> Controller 
</quoted>
